preconditions: this points to a live F1CVehicle instance; reads and conditional writes at +0x4410/+0x4424/+0x45F4 are in-bounds
postconditions: If the retired byte read at +0x4410 was 0: dword at +0x4424 is written 0 and byte at +0x45F4 is written 1
If the retired byte read at +0x4410 was nonzero: no fields are written
Return value equals the retired byte at +0x4410 read at entry in all paths
side_effects: Writes dword 0 to F1CVehicle+0x4424 (cleanup/disqualification flag) when vehicle is not retired
Writes byte 1 to F1CVehicle+0x45F4 (session-active / AI control flag) when vehicle is not retired
No callees; no global reads or writes

lifecycle.phase: per-frame maintenance of session-active and cleanup flags on a live F1CVehicle slot
